capabilities: Sync the vault across desktop and mobile via a user-run CouchDB server
Encrypt file content, paths, and metadata end-to-end before they leave the device
Resolve sync conflicts automatically or in a two-column diff view
Browse, diff, and restore previous revisions of a note
Mirror community plugins and their settings across devices
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list; install manually or via BRAT. The setup string contains server credentials (and optionally the passphrase) and should be treated like a password. Docs on server setup live in docs/server-setup.md in the repo. Not yet submitted to the community plugin list is noted in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault across devices through a server you control without that server being able to read your notes.

relations.evidence: keeps an Obsidian vault in sync across desktop and mobile through a CouchDB you control
You can also install directly from this repository with the BRAT plugin

requires.name: CouchDB endpoint over HTTPS with CORS enabled
IBM Cloudant account if using the hosted free-tier option

summary: Self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted vault sync over your own CouchDB, with a conflict diff view, file history, and passphrase rotation.
